$comment: Ramapo's schools as its current official schools page lists them. These are the
canonical school identities; each ID is persistent, so a future rename keeps it.
Reviewed September 23, 2026: the current official school pages and names are
canonical, and the former names the catalog and Archway still publish are reviewed
legacy names. Each legacy name records the evidence that the school succeeded it.
The School of Social Science and Human Services was split: its web section now
redirects to the School of Social Sciences and Social Work, and its education
programs are listed by the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education. A catalog
program still filed under it therefore has no single current school.
archway_groups are the exact Archway directory records (category Schools) that
publish a school's current or legacy name; each is reviewed, never matched by name.

legacy_names.evidence: https://www.ramapo.edu/sshs/ redirects (301, server rule) to https://www.ramapo.edu/sssw/; observed 2026-09-23.

legacy_names.evidence: https://www.ramapo.edu/tas/ redirects (301, server rule) to https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/; observed 2026-09-23.
